title: RNA-seq library QC gate before differential expression
objective: Assign a QC status to six poly(A) RNA-seq libraries from the deterministic QC engine and test the full and retained designs for batch confounding.

decision_questions.positive_despite_gate: Does any sample that is missing a required metric or fails a hard gate receive include or flag_for_review?
decision_questions.confounded_contrast_trusted: Does the result claim the retained design supports an interpretable treated-versus-control differential-expression contrast?

traps.S03: Best mapping rate (91.5%) and most genes detected (18,900), but RIN 5.9 is below the 6.0 warn floor of a hard-gate metric: FAIL, QUARANTINED.
traps.S02: RIN 7.0 and unique mapping 80.0% sit exactly on the pass thresholds, which are inclusive: PASS, include. A careless run flags it.
traps.S05: Every recorded metric is excellent, but RIN is missing; the engine returns INCOMPLETE and the data-completeness gate hard-blocks. Imputing a RIN gives include.
traps.S06: Passes both hard gates (RIN 8.1, mapping 86.3%), but rRNA 22.4% is past the 15% fail band for a poly(A) library: overall FAIL and the protocol-consistency gate fails.
traps.S04: Duplication 34% and NRF 0.71 are in their warn bands only: WARN, flag_for_review, not exclude.
traps.design: The full design is not confounded, but after removing S03, S05 and S06 every retained batch holds one condition (B1 = ctrl, B2 = treated), so check_batch_confound hard-blocks the retained design.
